verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents an AI Linter that checks pages against your own style guide, written as natural-language rules such as "Use active voice" (readme-docs-6, readme-docs-51). Docs Audit runs those rules across every page in one pass (readme-docs-7, readme-docs-52). Reviews let you run the AI Linter on changes in a branch before they reach the live hub (readme-docs-12, readme-docs-45, readme-docs-70), which covers the 'flag before publish' part. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration, and no evidence that lint checks automatically block publishing rather than being an optional review step.
